ai-wellness-pal-is-a-free.f73c4c:
AI Wellness Pal is a free AI wellness coach app for iPhone and Android. It answers one question each day: what should I do for my wellbeing right now?

You do a quick check-in, and the app builds Today’s Plan: two to four small, doable actions shaped around your energy, mood, body recovery and how much time you actually have. Everything else in the app supports that: tools to track the day, a Wellness Pal to talk it through, and progress you can see building up over time.
yes-ai-wellness-pal-is-free.97ded6:
Yes. AI Wellness Pal is free to download and use on iPhone and Android, with no ads. The free app includes daily check-ins and Today’s Plan, the AI journal, habits and challenges, hydration, sleep, period and weight tracking, meditation and breathing sessions, widgets and 3 Wellness Pal chat messages a day.

An optional Premium subscription adds unlimited chat, real-time voice conversations, AI food analysis, AI meal plans and the other AI coaching inside the toolkit. Compare Free and Premium.
how-much-does-ai-wellness-pal.f8dd05: How much does AI Wellness Pal Premium cost?
on-the-us-app-store-premium.614ba1: On the US App Store, Premium costs $14.99 a month or $89.99 a year, and both plans start with a 7-day free trial. Prices vary by country and currency; the App Store or Google Play shows the exact price before you confirm. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
is-ai-wellness-pal-available-on.d7c1d9: Is AI Wellness Pal available on iPhone and Android?
yes-download-it-from-the-app.3b28dc: Yes. Download it from the App Store (iPhone, iOS 15.0 or later) or Google Play (Android 8.0 or later). Sign in with the same account on both and your data syncs.
three-quick-steps-your-energy-1.0c92b4: Three quick steps: your energy (1–5), your mood, and how your body feels plus the time you have today. You can skip any step and the plan uses what you gave it. Once you’ve checked in, Today’s Plan is generated within a few seconds. You can also ask your Wellness Pal to “start my check-in” if you’d rather talk than tap.
is-ai-wellness-pal-medical-advice.c9ba67: Is AI Wellness Pal medical advice?
no-ai-wellness-pal-offers-general.f0e2b6:
No. AI Wellness Pal offers general wellness information and encouragement. It isn’t a medical device and doesn’t diagnose, treat or replace a doctor, therapist or other qualified professional. AI responses, calorie estimates and cycle predictions can be wrong, so talk to a healthcare provider about any health concern.

If you’re in crisis or thinking about harming yourself, contact your local emergency number right away. In the US, call or text 988. In the UK, call 111 or Samaritans on 116 123. Elsewhere, find a helpline at findahelpline.com.
which-ai-does-ai-wellness-pal.9b0dca: Which AI does AI Wellness Pal use?
the-ai-features-wellness-pal-chat.051403: The AI features (Wellness Pal chat and voice, journal insights, daily plans, sleep insights and nutrition analysis) are powered by Google’s Gemini models through Firebase AI Logic. Before any of your information is sent to the AI, the app shows you what will be shared and asks for your permission. AI responses can be inaccurate, so use them as guidance, not fact.
is-my-data-private-do-you.8c6b49: Is my data private? Do you sell it or show ads?
ai-wellness-pal-has-no-ads.d6418b: AI Wellness Pal has no ads, doesn’t sell your data and doesn’t track you across other companies’ apps or websites. Your data is stored in your own private area and isn’t shared with other users. Data is shared only with the service providers that run the app (such as Firebase for storage and Google Gemini for AI responses). Read the Privacy Policy for details.

ai-wellness-pal-is-available-in.1d9013: AI Wellness Pal is available in 23 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese and Korean. Choose yours in Settings → Language; the app, AI replies and Live Chat Pal all switch to it. With Live Chat Pal you can also turn on “Always speak English” if you want replies in English whatever language you speak.
who-is-ai-wellness-pal-for.573104: Who is AI Wellness Pal for?
adults-18-who-want-a-simple.64dda2: Adults (18+) who want a simple daily routine for their wellbeing: people who feel scattered by too many apps, want small steps that fit their real energy and time, and like having someone to talk things through with. It’s general wellness support, not a treatment for any condition.
what-do-i-get-with-premium.801147: What do I get with Premium?
unlimited-chat-with-your-wellness-pal.90: Unlimited chat with your Wellness Pal, Live Chat Pal real-time voice conversations, “Discuss” on your reflections, AI plans for your intentions, and the AI coaching inside the toolkit: nutrition analysis, meal plans, and sleep, hydration and calorie insights. You also get the full Wellness Studio library and AI-picked activities refreshed daily. All themes are free for everyone.
how-do-i-cancel-or-manage.a29ee1: How do I cancel or manage Premium?
on-iphone-go-to-settings-your.f2ad0e: On iPhone, go to Settings → your name → Subscriptions → AI Wellness Pal. On Android, open Google Play → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions. Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period to avoid the next renewal.
how-do-i-restore-a-purchase.071a8d: How do I restore a purchase on a new phone?
in-the-app-go-to-settings.d15863: In the app, go to Settings → Manage Subscription → Restore Purchases, signed in with the same Apple ID or Google account you subscribed with. Have a promo code? There’s a “Have a promo code?” option on the same screen.
each-action-has-a-checkbox-tick.a455bf: Each action has a checkbox. Tick them off as you go, and when you finish them all you get a small celebration. If your day changes, ask your Wellness Pal to update the plan (“I’m more tired than I thought”) and it rebuilds around how you actually feel.
longer-term-directions-rather-than-daily: Longer-term directions rather than daily tasks, like “sleep better”, “move more” or “feel calmer”. Your daily plans are shaped by them, and each one tracks its own progress. Premium members can have an intention broken into gentle daily steps automatically.
how-do-streaks-and-achievements-work.17a: How do streaks and achievements work?
Your streak counts consecutive days you’ve checked in, with celebrations at 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 50 and 100 days. Missing a day costs you a day rather than wiping the streak out. Achievements are badges for streaks, points, intentions, actions, reflections, studio sessions, meditation and challenges, from “First Sunrise” for your first check-in to “Zen Master” at 100 days.
how-do-i-talk-to-my.cb311c: How do I talk to my Wellness Pal?
tap-the-glowing-orb-button-to.70fea2: Tap the glowing orb button to open your Pal and start talking. To type instead, open your Pal and tap the smaller “Chat” orb. Free members get three messages a day; Premium is unlimited. Your three most recent conversations are kept as cards, and you can turn a useful one into a reflection.
what-can-the-wellness-pal-do.622b21: What can the Wellness Pal do?
more-than-talk-it-can-log.b5dcfd: More than talk. It can log water, meals, exercise, weight, a meditation session or a period start; create habits and set reminders; join challenges; run your check-in; rebuild Today’s Plan; add or remove Home cards; change your theme or text size; and open any screen. Just ask in your own words.
a-real-time-voice-conversation-you.c4dc0: A real-time voice conversation: you talk naturally and your Pal responds as you speak, rather than waiting for you to finish. It’s a Premium feature, turned on in Settings → AI Voice. With it on, you can also enable “Always listen for Pal” and just say “Hey Pal” while the app is open.
start-a-reflection-and-you-ll.d97cc4: Start a reflection and you’ll get prompts based on how your week has actually gone. Write your entry and your Pal responds with something supportive and specific. With Premium, tap “Discuss” on any reflection to talk it through and save anything useful as an Insight.
nine-tools-reached-from-the-more.219be0: Nine tools, reached from the “More” tab: Nutrition Coach, Meal Planner, Calorie Budget, Hydration Coach, Sleep Coach, Meditation Pal, Period Tracker, Body Weight and Mindful Travel.
does-ai-wellness-pal-work-with.c61a9f: Does AI Wellness Pal work with Apple Health or Health Connect?
yes-for-sleep-the-sleep-coach.f19722: Yes, for sleep. The Sleep Coach reads your sleep data from Apple Health on iPhone or Health Connect on Android, only after you allow it. The app reads sleep only and never writes health data. You can disconnect at any time in your phone’s settings.
short-guided-activities-for-right-now.93: Short guided activities for right now, usually 3–12 minutes, in six categories: Breathing Exercises, Recovery Challenges, Mindfulness Sessions, Wellness Quizzes, Pilates Knowledge Cards and Stress Recovery. Think Box Breathing, the 4-7-8 Calm Breath, a 5-Minute Stretch Reset or a Body Scan. At least three activities in each category are free.
ten-short-articles-roughly-3-5.638495: Ten short articles, roughly 3–5 minutes each, on mindfulness, sleep, movement, nutrition, mental health, stress relief, Pilates and yoga, all free. The app can read any of them aloud in your phone’s voice, and keeps going in the background with lock-screen controls.

ai-wellness-pal-is-a-free.9a94f9: AI Wellness Pal is a free AI wellness coach app for iPhone and Android. An AI companion, the Wellness Pal, helps you follow through, alongside a journal, habit tracking and nine everyday wellness tools.
why-ai-wellness-pal-exists-most.ec086f:
Why AI Wellness Pal exists

Most wellness apps hand you the same plan as everyone else. AI Wellness Pal asks how you’re actually doing first. Every morning a 30-second check-in captures your energy, your mood, how your body feels and how much time you genuinely have. Then your Pal builds Today’s Plan: two to four small, doable actions shaped around that answer. Exhausted with fifteen minutes free? You get a very different day than when you’re rested with an hour.

Everything else in the app supports that daily plan: tools to track meals, water, sleep, cycles and weight, a habit builder with challenges, a guided journal, and a Wellness Pal you can chat or talk with when you need it.
who-builds-it-ai-wellness-pal.f65824:
Who builds it

AI Wellness Pal is designed and built by Viraj Dhanushka, an independent developer. Feedback goes straight to the person who builds the app, and shapes what comes next. Send ideas, bugs or praise through the feedback form or by email.
how-the-ai-is-used-and.0d79b8:
How the AI is used, and its limits

The AI features use Google’s Gemini models through Firebase AI Logic. Before any of your information is sent to the AI, the app shows you what will be shared and asks for your permission. AI responses, calorie estimates and cycle predictions can be wrong; AI Wellness Pal provides general wellness information and is not a medical device or a substitute for professional care.
privacy-commitments-no-advertising-no-se:
Privacy commitments

  • No advertising, no selling of data, and no tracking across other companies’ apps or websites.
  • Health data is read only with your permission (sleep only) and never written back.
  • Delete your account and data at any time, in the app or on the web.

Full details are in the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

how-the-daily-check-in-works.a99767:
How the daily check-in works

  1. Energy: pick a level from 1 to 5, from “Completely Drained” to “Fully Energized”.
  2. Mood: how you feel emotionally right now.
  3. Body and time: how your body feels (your recovery) and how much time you have today.

You can skip any step and the plan uses what you gave it. Prefer to talk? Ask your Wellness Pal to “start my check-in”. Once you’ve checked in, Today’s Plan is ready within a few seconds.
what-s-in-today-s-plan.6d1a5e:
What’s in Today’s Plan

Two to four actions, each with a time estimate and a checkbox: think a short Pilates session, a few minutes of recovery stretches or a breathing exercise. Open any action for a friendly step-by-step guide, and set a one-time reminder if you want a nudge to do your plan later today. Tick actions off as you go; finish them all and you get a small celebration.

Days change. If you’re more tired than you thought, tell your Wellness Pal and it rebuilds the plan around how you actually feel.
plans-that-follow-your-bigger-goals.fcc8:
Plans that follow your bigger goals

Wellness Intentions are longer-term directions like “sleep better”, “move more” or “feel calmer”. Your daily plans are shaped by them, and each intention tracks its own progress. With Premium, an intention can be broken into gentle daily steps automatically.
progress-you-can-see-your-streak.32e41a:
Progress you can see

Your streak counts the days you check in, with celebrations at 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 50 and 100 days. Missing a day costs you a day rather than wiping the streak out. Achievements mark milestones from your first check-in (“First Sunrise”) to 100 days (“Zen Master”), and the Today’s Plan widget lets you tick actions straight from your home screen.

Live Chat Pal is a real-time voice conversation: you talk naturally and your Pal responds as you speak, rather than waiting for you to finish. Turn it on in Settings → AI Voice.   • add or remove cards on your Home screen, or change your theme or text size;
  • open any screen in the app.

personal-private-and-honest-about-its.66:

The Wellness Pal is powered by Google’s Gemini models. Before any of your information is shared with the AI, the app shows you what will be sent and asks your permission. Your Pal offers general wellness support, not therapy or medical advice. If you’re in crisis, contact your local emergency number; in the US you can call or text 988.

what-affects-your-sleep-sleep-factors.6e:
What affects your sleep

Sleep factors connect your night to your day, using what you’ve logged in the app: hydration, exercise, dinner timing and caffeine. A food and sleep card and a seven-day history help you spot patterns.
ai-sleep-insight-premium-with-premium.8e:
AI Sleep Insight (Premium)

With Premium you get a personalized summary of your sleep and what’s contributing to it, plus a “Try this tonight” suggestion you can add to your routine. Sleep summaries are sent to Google Gemini only after you give permission, and are never used for advertising.
build-better-sleep-habits-join-the.1b742:
Build better sleep habits

Join the 14-Day Sleep Routine challenge (in bed before 11 pm), and wind down with a sleep body scan or breathing session in Meditation Pal.
The Sleep Coach offers general wellness information. If you have ongoing sleep problems, talk to a doctor.
yes-connecting-apple-health-or-health.00: Yes. Connecting Apple Health or Health Connect, your sleep score, stages, sleep factors and history are free. The AI Sleep Insight is Premium.
the-sleep-coach-uses-the-sleep.2c02e3: The Sleep Coach uses the sleep data already in Apple Health or Health Connect, which can come from a watch, a sleep-tracking app or your phone. The more detailed that data, the more detailed your stages.
does-ai-wellness-pal-write-to.07b5b2: Does AI Wellness Pal write to Apple Health or Health Connect?
no-it-only-reads-your-sleep.6859a8: No. It only reads your sleep data, with your permission, and you can disconnect at any time in your phone’s settings.
how-is-the-sleep-score-calculated.55e0d4: How is the sleep score calculated?
from-four-things-duration-seven-to.0f763: From four things: duration (seven to nine hours is ideal), deep and REM sleep, sleep efficiency and schedule consistency, combined into a 0 to 100 score.
wellness-reads-ready-to-read-aloud.4f824: Wellness Reads, ready to read aloud
multi-day-challenges-like-the-14.9e7edd: Multi-day challenges like the 14-Day Sleep Routine
breathing-exercises-in-the-ai-wellness.7: Breathing exercises in the AI Wellness Pal Wellness Studio
meditation-breathing-exercises-app-ai-we: Meditation & Breathing Exercises App | AI Wellness Pal
calm-down-in-minutes-with-box.ce0467: Calm down in minutes with Box Breathing, 4-7-8, body scans and step-by-step stress relief in Meditation Pal, plus quick Wellness Studio activities. Free.
breathe-meditate-and-find-your-calm.ce14: Breathe, meditate and find your calm in minutes
meditation-pal-in-ai-wellness-pal.633add: Meditation Pal in AI Wellness Pal gives you guided breathing, body scans, meditation sessions and step-by-step stress relief in 1 to 15 minutes, all free, plus a Wellness Studio of quick activities.
breathing-you-can-follow-choose-box.db31:
Breathing you can follow

Choose Box, 4-7-8, Calm or Stress Relief breathing for 1, 3, 5 or 10 minutes. An animated breathing orb and gentle haptic cues tell you when to breathe in, hold and breathe out, so you can close your eyes.
Body scans and meditation sessions

Body scans in four lengths (Quick 5 minutes, Stress Release 8, Sleep 10 and Full 15) and ten meditation sessions across nine themes, each 5 to 15 minutes, guided by a calming timer with breathing cues. There are wind-down sessions for bedtime too.
stress-relief-step-by-step-five.680506:
Stress relief, step by step

Five short exercises that walk you through calming down when stress spikes, one step at a time.
reminders-progress-and-badges-set-medita:
Reminders, progress and badges

Set meditation reminders for the days and times that suit you (like a morning, afternoon or bedtime session), track your sessions and minutes, earn meditation badges, and join the 14-Day Meditation Challenge. Your Wellness Pal can log a session for you too.
Wellness Studio

Thirty quick activities of 3 to 12 minutes in six categories: Breathing Exercises, Recovery Challenges, Mindfulness Sessions, Wellness Quizzes, Pilates Knowledge Cards and Stress Recovery. Three in every category are free, like Box Breathing, a 5-Minute Stretch Reset, a Body Scan Meditation and the Stress Awareness Quiz. Premium unlocks the rest, plus personalized picks.
wellness-reads-ten-short-articles-on.b08:
Wellness Reads

Ten short articles on mindfulness, sleep, movement, nutrition, mental health, stress relief, Pilates and yoga, all free. The app can read any of them aloud in your phone’s voice, and keeps reading in the background with lock-screen controls.
are-the-meditation-and-breathing-exercis: Are the meditation and breathing exercises free?
yes-every-meditation-pal-session-breathi: Yes. Every Meditation Pal session (breathing, body scans, meditations and stress relief) is free, and so are three activities in each Wellness Studio category. Premium unlocks the full Studio and personalized recommendations.
meditation-pal-sessions-are-guided-by.88: Meditation Pal sessions are guided by a timer, a breathing animation and haptic cues rather than recorded narration. Wellness Reads can be read aloud by your phone’s voice.
breathing-sessions-run-1-to-10.84e2c9: Breathing sessions run 1 to 10 minutes, body scans and meditations 5 to 15 minutes, and Studio activities 3 to 12 minutes.
period-tracker-showing-cycle-day-3.5dc52: Period tracker showing cycle day 3 of 28 in the menstrual phase
period-tracker-with-cycle-predictions-ph: Period Tracker with Cycle Predictions & Phase Tips | AI Wellness Pal
track-your-cycle-in-ai-wellness.5944b8: Track your cycle in AI Wellness Pal: log period starts, see your cycle day and phase, your predicted next period and fertile window, and get gentle tips for each phase.
a-period-tracker-that-fits-into.58b745: A period tracker that fits into your whole day
log-your-period-starts-and-ai.5a2498: Log your period starts and AI Wellness Pal shows your cycle day, current phase, predicted next period and estimated fertile window, with tips for each phase and plans that adapt to it.
your-cycle-at-a-glance-log.b21442:
Your cycle at a glance

Log the first day of each period and the tracker shows where you are: your cycle day, the current phase (menstrual, follicular, ovulation or luteal), when your next period is likely, and an estimated ovulation date and fertile window. If a period is late, it tells you how many days.
predictions-that-learn-your-rhythm-set.3:
Predictions that learn your rhythm

Set your usual cycle and period length to start. As you log more periods, predictions use the average of your own logged cycles, so they reflect your rhythm rather than a textbook 28 days.
tips-for-each-phase-and-a.d4dd99:
Tips for each phase, and a plan that adapts

Each phase comes with gentle tips, like resting and being kind to yourself, with light movement, warmth and hydration during your period. Your daily plan adapts to the phase too.
reminders-and-widgets-turn-on-cycle.b08e:
Reminders and widgets

Turn on cycle reminders in your notification preferences (they appear once you’ve logged period data), and add the Period Tracker widget to see your phase and cycle day on your home screen. You can also just tell your Wellness Pal “my period started today”.
predictions-are-estimates-and-aren-t.9ff: Predictions are estimates and aren’t suitable for contraception or conception planning. Talk to a healthcare provider about your cycle or any concerns.
yes-logging-periods-predictions-phases-a: Yes. Logging periods, predictions, phases and tips are part of the free app on iPhone and Android.
how-does-ai-wellness-pal-predict.3ca295: How does AI Wellness Pal predict my next period?
it-adds-your-average-cycle-length.0e11db: It adds your average cycle length to your last logged period start. With two or more logged periods, it uses the average gap between your own cycles; otherwise it uses the cycle length you set.
can-i-use-it-for-birth.a5971a: Can I use it for birth control or to get pregnant?
no-predictions-are-estimates-and-aren.56: No. Predictions are estimates and aren’t suitable for contraception or conception planning. Talk to a healthcare provider.
body-weight-tracker-with-trend-chart.68a: Body weight tracker with trend chart and BMI in AI Wellness Pal
weight-bmi-tracker-with-trend-chart.d5ae: Weight & BMI Tracker with Trend Chart | AI Wellness Pal
log-your-weight-in-kg-or.1f8e48: Log your weight in kg or lb and see your trend over time, your change since you started, your lowest and highest weigh-ins and your BMI, all in AI Wellness Pal.
track-your-weight-and-bmi-without.170022: Track your weight and BMI without the obsession
body-weight-in-ai-wellness-pal.d5e53e: Body Weight in AI Wellness Pal keeps a simple record of your weigh-ins with a trend chart, your overall change and your BMI, so you see the direction, not just the daily wobble.
simple-weigh-ins-log-a-weigh.aff50a:
Simple weigh-ins

Log a weigh-in in a couple of taps, in kilograms or pounds. Or just tell your Wellness Pal your weight and it logs it for you.
see-the-trend-not-the-noise.2abb63:
See the trend, not the noise

Weight moves day to day. The trend chart shows the direction over time, alongside your current weight, the change since your first entry, your lowest and highest weigh-ins and how many entries you’ve logged. Your full history is there to scroll back through.
body-mass-index-add-your-height.d04bf0:
Body Mass Index

Add your height once and your BMI is calculated from your latest weigh-in, shown with its category. BMI is a rough screening number, not a measure of health on its own, so treat it as one signal among many.
part-of-the-bigger-picture-weight.fc19fc:
Part of the bigger picture

Weight sits next to your nutrition, calorie budget and habits in the same app, and the Body Weight widget can show your current weight and recent change on your home screen.
yes-logging-weigh-ins-the-trend.4ded84: Yes. Logging weigh-ins, the trend chart and BMI are part of the free app.
can-i-use-pounds-instead-of.c7a2d1: Can I use pounds instead of kilograms?
yes-switch-between-kg-and-lb.8f9c22: Yes, switch between kg and lb at any time.
from-your-latest-weigh-in-and.662aff: From your latest weigh-in and the height you add, using the standard BMI formula and adult categories. It’s a general screening measure, not a diagnosis.
create-a-habit-with-a-target.d4ea68: Create a habit with a target
habit-builder-with-starter-habits-and.60: Habit Builder with starter habits and challenges in AI Wellness Pal
habit-tracker-with-reminders-streaks-cha: Habit Tracker with Reminders, Streaks & Challenges | AI Wellness Pal
build-healthy-habits-in-ai-wellness.5a05: Build healthy habits in AI Wellness Pal: daily, weekday or custom schedules, reminders, streaks and challenges for water, walking, meditation, sugar and sleep.
build-habits-that-stick-one-small.86a1cb: Build habits that stick, one small win at a time
the-habit-builder-in-ai-wellness.bb3bfb: The Habit Builder in AI Wellness Pal turns good intentions into a routine: habits on your own schedule, optional reminders, streaks, and multi-day challenges with achievements when you finish.
habits-on-your-schedule-create-a.feeb10:
Habits on your schedule

Create a habit from a suggestion or from scratch, link it to a tool like the Hydration Coach or Calorie Budget, and set how often it happens: every day, weekdays, weekends or custom days. Add a target and unit if it helps, such as steps, litres, minutes or calories.
reminders-that-show-up-on-time.c988c3:
Reminders that show up on time

Give any habit an optional reminder time. If you’ve already done it today, today’s reminder is skipped, and it comes back tomorrow. You can also ask your Wellness Pal to “remind me to stretch at 7 pm”.
challenges-with-an-end-point-a.685060:
Challenges with an end point

A challenge is a multi-day commitment you join and log each day. Current challenges include:

  • 7-Day Hydration Challenge: drink your daily water target for seven days in a row;
  • 30-Day Walking Challenge: reach your daily step target;
  • 14-Day Meditation Challenge: meditate at least five minutes a day;
  • Cut Back on Sugar Challenge: reduce added sugar for seven days;
  • 14-Day Sleep Routine: be in bed before 11 pm for 14 nights.

Finishing a challenge earns points and unlocks an achievement.
tick-habits-off-from-your-home.ffecdb:
Tick habits off from your home screen

The Today’s Habits widget shows what’s left today with checkboxes you can tap without opening the app, on iPhone and Android.
Yes. Habits, reminders, streaks, challenges and the Today’s Habits widget are part of the free app.
can-a-habit-repeat-only-on.43e5d1: Can a habit repeat only on some days?
yes-every-day-weekdays-weekends-or.d090c: Yes: every day, weekdays, weekends, or custom days of the week.
what-s-the-difference-between-a.ea4f7c: What’s the difference between a habit and a challenge?
a-habit-is-part-of-your.a32851: A habit is part of your routine with its own schedule and optional reminder. A challenge is a multi-day commitment with an end point, like the 30-Day Walking Challenge, and finishing it unlocks an achievement.
wellness-widgets-for-iphone-android-home: Wellness Widgets for iPhone & Android Home Screens | AI Wellness Pal
ai-wellness-pal-widgets-put-today.569112: AI Wellness Pal widgets put Today’s Plan, habits, water, nutrition, calories, cycle and weight on your iPhone or Android home screen, tickable without opening the app.
your-wellbeing-right-on-your-home.c04fcb: Your wellbeing, right on your home screen
ai-wellness-pal-s-widgets-show.087637: AI Wellness Pal’s widgets show today’s plan, habits and wellness tools at a glance, and let you tick things off without opening the app, on both iPhone and Android.
plan-and-habits-widgets-today-s.58bb72:
Plan and habits widgets

  • Today’s Plan: today’s focus and actions, with checkboxes you can tick from the home screen and progress for the day.
  • Today’s Habits: what’s left today, ready to tick off.
  • Wellness Intention: your current intention’s tasks and progress.
a-widget-for-every-tool-small.b30bc1:
A widget for every tool

Small widgets for the Life Toolkit: Hydration Coach, Nutrition Coach, Meal Planner, Calorie Budget, Period Tracker, Body Weight, Sleep Coach, Meditation Pal and Mindful Travel. Tap one to jump straight into that tool.

Tool widgets with data have a flip button that turns the tile over to show today’s numbers: water progress, calories and macros, kcal left, your cycle phase and day, your current weight, or today’s meals (with arrows to browse them).
made-to-match-your-home-screen.be53fd:
Made to match your home screen

Each widget has its own light and dark switch, so you can match it to your wallpaper. Widgets update as you use the app.
how-to-add-a-widget-iphone.1b85d2:
How to add a widget

iPhone: long-press an empty area of your home screen, tap +, search for “AI Wellness Pal”, choose a widget and size, and tap Add Widget.

Android: long-press your home screen, tap Widgets, find AI Wellness Pal and drag the widget you want onto your home screen.
yes-all-widgets-are-part-of.9a5af5: Yes. All widgets are part of the free app on iPhone and Android.
can-i-tick-off-actions-from.2ff41f: Can I tick off actions from the widget?
yes-the-today-s-plan-and.ecf9ab: Yes. The Today’s Plan and Today’s Habits widgets have checkboxes that work without opening the app.
why-does-my-widget-look-out.c47c6d: Why does my widget look out of date?
your-phone-decides-how-often-widgets.223: Your phone decides how often widgets refresh, so they can lag a little. Opening the app syncs them immediately, including anything you ticked from the home screen.
our-privacy-policy-and-terms-of.8d3117: Our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are available in English.
